replacementRule: Replacement requires proof that the current solution has reached its practical limit after research, benchmark, optimisation, latest workflow testing, and practical-limit documentation.

capabilities.name: LLM
capabilities.purpose: Understand Traditional Chinese requests, plan content, create scripts, reason over quality reports, and orchestrate generation steps.
capabilities.currentImplementation: Codex/OpenAI-assisted engineering and local app rule-based generation.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure Traditional Chinese intent parsing, structured JSON output, script quality, reproducibility, privacy, and cost.
freeServiceCandidates: free/open model endpoints where reputable and privacy-safe

capabilities.name: Image Generation
capabilities.purpose: Generate and edit product, brand, scene, thumbnail, and reference visuals.
capabilities.currentImplementation: No production generator connected; V1 uses uploaded photos and generated placeholder frames.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure prompt adherence, product consistency, typography, editability, cost, local viability, and automation.
freeServiceCandidates: free tiers from reputable image providers if privacy-safe

capabilities.name: Identity Preservation
capabilities.purpose: Preserve Emma or product identity across scenes, poses, outfits and environments.
capabilities.currentImplementation: Governance defined; no automated identity scorer implemented.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure face/body/product consistency, style variance tolerance, and false accept/reject rate.
paidServiceCandidates: paid vision evaluation APIs if materially better

capabilities.name: Character Training
capabilities.purpose: Create durable Emma visual and voice identity assets.
capabilities.currentImplementation: Not started; requires approved Emma source material.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure training data requirement, identity fidelity, update cost, privacy, and reproducibility.
freeServiceCandidates: free training notebooks where license/privacy permit

capabilities.name: Video Generation
capabilities.purpose: Generate product clips, scene clips, motion backgrounds, and image-to-video outputs.
capabilities.currentImplementation: V1 uses FFmpeg Ken Burns-style local assembly from images.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure motion naturalness, temporal stability, prompt adherence, speed, VRAM, and playback quality.
freeServiceCandidates: reputable free video generation tiers if privacy-safe

capabilities.name: Talking Head
capabilities.purpose: Animate Emma or presenter head/face for spoken content.
capabilities.currentImplementation: Not in production; prior experiments are not active V1 inputs.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure identity preservation, expression naturalness, head motion, artifacts, and runtime.
paidServiceCandidates: paid avatar/talking-head APIs if clearly superior

capabilities.name: Full Body Animation
capabilities.purpose: Animate Emma full-body movement while preserving identity and proportions.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure body consistency, pose control, motion naturalness, clothing stability, and identity drift.

capabilities.name: Lip Sync
capabilities.purpose: Align mouth motion to generated or recorded voice.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure lip-sync accuracy, face quality, identity retention, language support, and speed.
paidServiceCandidates: paid dubbing/lip-sync APIs if clearly superior

capabilities.name: Voice Cloning
capabilities.purpose: Preserve Emma voice identity or generate brand-consistent narration voices.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure speaker similarity, intelligibility, emotion, Traditional Chinese quality, training burden, and privacy.
freeServiceCandidates: open-source hosted demos only when privacy-safe

capabilities.name: TTS
capabilities.currentImplementation: V1 uses text narration files; no audio synthesis connected.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure naturalness, Traditional Chinese pronunciation, speed, cost, and automation.
freeServiceCandidates: free TTS services where terms/privacy permit

capabilities.name: Subtitle
capabilities.purpose: Generate, align, style and validate Traditional Chinese subtitles.
capabilities.currentImplementation: V1 generates timeline-based SRT from scene durations.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure timing accuracy, readability, line length, safe area, and Traditional Chinese quality.

capabilities.name: Editing
capabilities.purpose: Assemble clips, subtitles, audio, pacing, transitions, CTA, and platform exports.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure render speed, format correctness, subtitle style, automation, maintainability, and playback reliability.
freeServiceCandidates: none preferred until local limit is proven
paidServiceCandidates: cloud render services if local rendering becomes bottleneck

capabilities.name: Music
capabilities.purpose: Add safe background music or generated audio mood where business-appropriate.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure licensing safety, mood fit, loop quality, mix quality, cost, and privacy.
freeServiceCandidates: royalty-free/free music libraries with clear licenses

capabilities.name: Automation
capabilities.purpose: Orchestrate one-click workflows, retries, logs, recovery, and support packages.
capabilities.currentImplementation: V1 app has local workflow, backup, restore, support package and quality checker entry point.
capabilities.currentBenchmarkTarget: Measure end-to-end reliability, recoverability, retry behavior, operator burden, and maintainability.
paidServiceCandidates: managed workflow tools only if operationally justified
